decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the accepted gravity-fed solenoid path and absence of retained matcha; no additional state change is needed.
Adding electrical valve actuation does not alter the existing requirement that the bottom seal prevent liquid from reaching electronics.
The accepted dispensing mechanism does not remove or modify the requirement for effective spout cleaning between uses.
The solenoid-valve decision does not change the requirement that plumbing and bowl seals prevent leakage into the base.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the accepted rendered appearance, stainless-steel material, and custom fabrication.
The statement that the spout will face the baristas confirms, but does not change, the existing barista-facing orientation.
The accepted electrically actuated solenoid and station-button behavior must be represented in the required wiring plan.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Go ahead with that approach, and please match the rendering as closely as possible; I really like both its appearance and functionality. I do want one change from the rendering: move the plate labeled "Elena's Chai Whisk" from the back of the machine to the front. The spout and mixers will face the baristas, while customers will view the machine from another angle, so the "Elena's Chai Whisk" plate needs to face the customer.
